data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Gale is a name for the west wind. This name is derived from the Greek word ‘galē’ which means ‘sea wave’ or ‘wave’. Gale is also the name of a goddess of the winds in Roman mythology. The name Gale carries the meaning “Sea Wave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gale usually hope their child will grow to embody sea wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gale total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
